messages:
maria: [async standup] Yesterday: finished promptset cleanup for the span detector, ran evals against synth-v2 and flagged 3 regression clusters. Blockers: kv warmup on quant-serve is flaky, causing slower cold starts — need eng-runtime help. Today: land prompt fixes, open CR for tokenizer tweak, rerun evals after fixes.

alex: Noted — can you paste the failing log or CI id? I can look into runtime tomorrow morning.

maria: log snippet: ```ERROR: kv_warmup timeout after 12s for model llama3-smallq /mnt/cache/kv_persist``` CI job: #4521. cc @sasha for rollout policy thoughts.

sasha: I saw similar flakes earlier. If kv warmup times out we can temporarily increase warmup timeout for the canary. Also the spanish prompt examples had a tokenization edgecase; pushed a small change to PR #887 that normalizes punctuation.

sam: Code review ping: @maria opened PR #887 with prompt fixes, left a couple nits. I'll review this afternoon. FYI I've queued a rerun of the eval harness: `./scripts/run_evals --suite=span-detector --models=llama3-smallq`

ci-bot: Build #4521 failed on kv_warmup; retry scheduled by @alex. Logs: https://ci/internal/4521 :gear:

maria: Thanks. For rollouts I'd prefer canary + immediate fallback to llama3-compat if warmup fails. Added a tiny config to the console: ```fallback_model: llama3-compat
warmup_timeout_sec: 20
canary_percentage: 5```

alex: Sounds good. I'll bump the warmup on the canary, retry CI, and if stable we'll promote. :thumbsup:

sasha: Leaving a TODO to add a prompt regression unit for the Spanish punctuation case so it doesn't silently slip next time. I'll add it to promptset/tests.

maria: Great — blockers mostly cleared. @sam once CR is green let's merge and I'll trigger a full eval pass and post results here. Thanks team!
